message:
fix: delay-load winhvplatform.dll to prevent loader crash on WHP-less hosts (#1059)

* fix: delay-load winhvplatform.dll to prevent loader crash on WHP-less hosts (#1053)

wxc-exec.exe statically imported winhvplatform.dll through the upstream
hyperlight-host crate, causing STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND (0xC0000135) on hosts
without the Windows Hypervisor Platform feature enabled — before main()
runs, killing --probe and every other backend.

Changes:
- Add /DELAYLOAD:winhvplatform.dll + delayimp.lib linker flags in
  wxc/build.rs when the hyperlight feature is active, converting the
  import from static to delay-loaded.
- Add hyperlight_common::is_whp_available() that probes via LoadLibraryW
  to detect WHP presence at runtime.
- Pre-check WHP in resolve_hyperlight() so a missing DLL becomes a typed
  unsupported_containment error instead of a delay-load SEH exception.
- Report Hyperlight in the --probe / available_backends() output when WHP
  is present, matching the pattern used by other optional backends.
- Add scripts/check-no-static-whp-import.js regression test that parses
  the PE import table and asserts winhvplatform.dll (and other optional-
  feature DLLs) do not appear as static imports.

Closes #1053
